cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sunday's off again? Mum's made up the bed. You're telling her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed. I'll check when she's home; you make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write you an opening line. You're arranging the next visit with her, too.

reason: Replace generic status with bounded help on timing and wording, while repeated cancellation and the softening request cause A to add future arrangement responsibility.
